text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lagos state military administrator escapes bomb attack.

- Achieving an exchange rate of $1=56 naira is the thrust of a new foreign exchange policy being considered by government for inclusion in the 1997 budget due on January 1. Sources at the Presidency said the proposed exchange rate would be the spine of harmonization of the current dual exchange system. The official rate is $1=22 naira and at the autonomous rate $1=80 naira.
- Work was halted on Monday at the National Insurance Corporation of Nigeria by laid-off workers protesting the non-payment of pensions.
- Top level meetings have begun in Abuja to make final preparations for the 1997 budget.

- Members of the electricity workers' union say they are in favour of private participation in power generation, but are opposed to the outright privatisation of the National Electric Power Authority.
- The Nigerian Navy is lobbying for the exclusive right to handle security at seaports.
